channel.title: Counterwise — The Buyer's Notebook
channel.description: Question-shaped guides for choosing air fryers and kitchen thermometers. Every fact dated and sourced.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two formats, two different sets of trade-offs. The useful comparison is not which one is better, but which one fits how you cook.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity labels answer the wrong question most of the time. Here is the small set of measurements that actually decides whether an appliance fits your life.

item.title: Cleanup and counter space: the trade-offs to assess
item.description: The friction that decides whether you still use an appliance in month three is rarely on the product page.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function appliance
item.description: A long feature list makes comparison harder, not easier. Start from the jobs you would actually replace.

item.title: Air fryer toaster oven vs. a plain air fryer: which problem are you actually solving?
item.description: One of these is a fryer with an oven attached. That is a genuinely different machine, and it is not the right answer for everyone.

item.title: Dual-basket air fryers: what does cooking two things at once really change?
item.description: Two baskets sound like a gimmick until you have cooked for two people who want different things at the same time.

item.title: Your first air fryer: five questions that decide it before you spend anything
item.description: You do not need a feature comparison to choose well. You need five answers about your own kitchen.

item.title: Instant-read vs. leave-in thermometer: which one actually changes your cooking?
item.description: They solve different problems. The honest question is which problem you have.

item.title: How to judge thermometer accuracy without taking the marketing at face value
item.description: Every thermometer listing claims accuracy. Here is how to read the claim properly, and how to check the device.
